en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large early‑20th‑century building complex in a European city. The architecture features steep tiled mansard and gabled roofs with dormer windows, stucco façades with decorative details, balconies, and an arched entrance gate leading into a landscaped courtyard. To the right stands an older church‑like structure with thick stone walls and a bulbous onion‑domed tower. A few people walk on the wide street in the foreground; leafless trees suggest late autumn or winter. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
